book.darkrifts.page1:
§5§lDark Rifts Codex§r

The road: Ancient City -> Ritual Altar -> Rift Reaver -> Mirror Blade -> Dark Mirror -> Mirrorite -> Rift gear.

The Reaver stands before the Ender Dragon.
book.darkrifts.page2:
§51. Echo Shards§r

Echo Shards grow in Ancient Cities, deep under the world. You need 2 for the altar, 3 for each Mirror Blade, and you will take more from the Reaver.
book.darkrifts.page3:
§52. Ritual Altar§r

Craft: 6 Obsidian, 1 Crying Obsidian, 2 Echo Shards (shards on the top corners, crying obsidian between them).
Place it on open ground with a clear sky above.
book.darkrifts.page4:
§53. The Ritual§r

Right Click the altar with an Eye of Ender. For twelve seconds the world shakes, runes burn and rifts open. The altar is consumed.
book.darkrifts.page5:
§54. Rift Reaver§r

A mid-game boss: 300 health. It slams the ground, calls spikes and drags you in. At half health it goes berserk. Bring diamond gear, potions and a wide arena.
book.darkrifts.page6:
§55. Spoils§r

The Reaver always drops a Reaver Heart. It also drops Echo Shards, Ender Pearls and Netherite Scrap.
book.darkrifts.page7:
§56. Mirror Blade§r

Reaver Heart + Iron Sword + 3 Echo Shards (shapeless).

One use only. Hold Right Click, look up and drag your view to draw a rift. When the rift is finished the blade shatters.
book.darkrifts.page8:
§57. Dark Mirror§r

The rift leads to a ruined copy of your world under eternal night. A return rift stays beside where you arrive. Rifts you draw collapse after 5 minutes.
book.darkrifts.page9:
§58. Mirror Ore§r

Mirror Ore grows underground in the Dark Mirror, as veins in stone and deepslate. Mine it with a Diamond Pickaxe, smelt the Raw Mirrorite into Mirrorite Ingots.
book.darkrifts.page10:
§59. Mirrorite Arsenal§r

Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe: a little better than diamond.
Sword and Axe: 25% to slow and weaken what they hit.
Mirror Bow (3 Ingots + 3 String): +damage, arrows pierce 2 targets.
book.darkrifts.page11:
§510. Rift Blade§r

Netherite Sword + 3 Mirrorite Ingots + Eye of Ender.

The reusable blade. Press R to choose an ability: Rift, Spikes, Step, Collapse, Cloak, Seal, Spike Wave, Slash, Strike, Drain, Barrier.
book.darkrifts.page12:
§511. Rift Armor§r

Netherite piece + 4 Mirrorite Ingots + Eye of Ender.

Full set: no fall damage, +4 hearts, Speed II, magic -50%, projectiles -25%.

Rift Ward (8 s): a hit of 5+ damage tears a rift around you, softens the blow and blasts enemies away.

Seal sends a player to the Void Prison; only the one who sealed them can free them.
book.darkrifts.page13:
§512. The Sanctum§r

In the Dark Mirror, at x1000 z1000, stands the Sanctum: a plateau with four towers and an altar. Put a Reaver Heart on the pedestal of each tower, then the Dragon Egg on the altar in the middle. The Mirror Sovereign tears out of the sky and never leaves its dais. Command: /darkrifts sanctum.
